name: Tamarind, Guava & Mint Agua Fresca
desc: Inspired by Mexican aguas frescas: refreshing guava, dark tamarind and clean mint.
ing: 1 tsp smooth seedless tamarind concentrate, no added sugar
160 ml coconut water, no added sugar
Water, as needed to reach 800–850 ml TOTAL volume in jug (not extra)
method: Wash and prepare all fruit and fresh herbs, removing stones, pips and tough skins. Use unsweetened food-grade purées or infusions.
Put ingredients into the one-litre soup-maker jug; top up with cold water only to 800–850 ml TOTAL contents, keeping between the 800 ml MIN and 1,000 ml MAX fill marks.
Run the UNHEATED Drinks/Blend programme for approximately 2 minutes.
Taste and serve cool. These are fruit-led interpretations of traditional drinks, not claims of strict regional authenticity.
science: Fruit contributes fibre and varying vitamins; cultured dairy provides protein where used. Nutrition estimates await calculation.
note: Project 400 · Global drink inspirations · ££ · Spring · An interpretation, not a traditional recipe. Untested idea. ID P400-095.
